raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PAK-ResilientAccessibleMicrofinance",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Recurrent severe flood events can cause a sharp spike in non-performing loans (NPLs) and deplete capital adequacy across microfinance banks.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Establish and capitalize the Climate Risk Fund (CRF) to deploy post-disaster Contingent Liquidity Facility (CLF) loans for loan restructuring and recovery lending.",
      "evidence": "NPLs of MFBs in flood impacted areas surged by 25.7 percent... capital adequacy declined from 14.9 percent to 11.7 percent"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Microfinance providers may disinvest or de-risk away from agricultural lending due to acute climate vulnerability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide pre-disaster Innovative Agricultural Liquidity (IAL) bundled with agricultural technology company (ATC) advisory services to enhance farm yield and de-risk lending.",
      "evidence": "The share of agriculture in total lending of MFBs has declined from 34 percent in fiscal year (FY)19 to 28 percent in FY24."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Delays or omissions in requesting local currency budget allocations by GoP could block Category 2 disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Ensure project funding allocations are explicitly requested and integrated into the GoP annual national budget planning process.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawals can take place under Category 2 until the Recipient has ensured... sufficient amount in its currency has been requested in its budget allocation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Post-disaster mobility constraints and gender bias may restrict female borrowers' equitable access to recovery microfinance.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Mandate a 55% beneficiary target for women backed by higher borrowing costs for non-compliant MFPs, loan officer training, and targeted financial literacy programs.",
      "evidence": "post-disaster settings further restrict women’s access... MFPs will be required to pay a higher borrowing cost... in instances there is deviation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Inadequate data or flawed catastrophe modeling could prevent accurate trigger calibration for contingent liquidity and insurance backstops.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage specialized third-party flood risk modeling firms and credit rating agencies to provide independently verifiable data for parametric triggers.",
      "evidence": "Expansion of coverage to additional climate risks will require adequate risk modelling and data to design and implement the financial instruments"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "High costs or market fluctuations for parametric international reinsurance could erode CRF capital or make reinsurance coverage unsustainable.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Perform annual financial modeling of CRF sustainability and utilize GSFF grant funds combined with CRF investment income to subsidize backstop premiums.",
      "evidence": "financial modelling on the sustainability of the CRF will be undertaken annually to inform this decision making."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Geographic clustering of agricultural loans may lead to cumulative environmental risks from increased pesticide and chemical fertilizer use.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce the project Environmental and Social Commitment Plan (ESCP) and apply SBP's Environmental and Social Management Systems to promote sustainable practices.",
      "evidence": "clustering of loans in geographical areas... where project interventions may increase use of fertilizers, pesticides and other chemicals."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Delays in executing and legally registering the Trust Deed between Ministry of Finance and SBP could delay project effectiveness.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize legal execution and registration of the Trust Deed as an explicit legal condition precedent to project effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "Effectiveness 5.01(a): The Trust Deed... has been executed between the Recipient, through its Ministry of Finance and State Bank of Pakistan and registered"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Microfinance market pivot towards short-term urban nano loans for consumption could undermine long-term productive micro-enterprise growth.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Restrict CRF liquidity deployment strictly to productive climate-smart agricultural loans and structured post-disaster recovery credit.",
      "evidence": "Nano loans have grown by 342 percent... indicating an alarming pivot away from lending for productive purposes to consumption smoothing."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "MFPs may lack organizational capacity or experience to effectively integrate agritech company (ATC) services into loan products.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Execute the Agriculture Finance Innovation Challenge (AFIC) to pre-select capable ATCs and build operational capacity across participating MFPs.",
      "evidence": "MFPs that avail the IAL product will have to partner with at least one ATC selected under the AFIC"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Complex pooling and multi-tier tracking of grant and loan accounts could create fiduciary and accounting errors.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain segregated child accounts within the pooled account, perform biannual internal audits, and subject financial statements to annual Auditor General audits.",
      "evidence": "The recipient will establish a pooled account – with segregated child accounts... SBP will maintain separate books of accounts"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Sluggish administrative processing after a flood could delay deployment of contingent liquidity beyond the crucial 60-day window for borrower recovery.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear parametric triggers, pre-agreed data protocols, and streamlined Working Committee approval workflows in the Project Operating Manual (POM).",
      "evidence": "CRF liquidity which is deployed to originate loans within 60 days of qualifying floods (percentage)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Failure or delay in executing the Co-financing Agreement could block overall project effectiveness.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Maintain active coordination between the Ministry of Finance, SBP, and co-financing grant partners to finalize agreements ahead of approval dates.",
      "evidence": "Effectiveness 5.01(c) The Co-financing Agreement has been executed and delivered and all conditions precedent to its effectiveness... have been fulfilled"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Localized, severe flooding could severely impair specific MFP portfolios without triggering official government emergency declarations.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include a secondary portfolio-impact threshold trigger in the POM allowing individual affected MFPs to access CLF liquidity without formal district emergency declarations.",
      "evidence": "If the government does not declare an emergency... but a predetermined threshold of the portfolio of a particular MFP is impacted by the floods"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Recurrent severe flood events can cause a sharp spike in non-performing loans (NPLs) and deplete capital adequacy across microfinance banks.
